stories.title: Grieving parents call for kratom crackdown
stories.summary: Rebecca Strang, who said she lost her son to kratom 58 days ago, is in Washington advocating for a crackdown. Iowa Sen. Chuck Grassley supports the call.

stories.title: Woman says she found maggots crawling on her LongHorn Steakhouse meal, lawsuit says
stories.summary: An Alabama woman is suing LongHorn Steakhouse, claiming she found maggots on broccoli she ordered from the restaurant.

stories.title: Body camera video shows arrest of mother after toddler nearly dies from fentanyl overdose
stories.summary: Police in Arizona have released body camera video showing the arrest of a mother after her toddler nearly overdosed on fentanyl this summer.

stories.title: Record number of women elected to 120th Congress
stories.summary: At least 162 women will serve when the 120th Congress is sworn in Jan. 3, 2027, the most ever. However, women will still only make up about 30% of all lawmakers.

stories.title: Niece escapes after car drives into river, leaving aunt and 13-year-old cousin dead
stories.summary: The bodies of a mother and daughter were pulled from a vehicle found in the Thorne River this week.

stories.title: ‘Unknown’ illness causes nearly 150 aboard cruise ship to get sick with vomiting, diarrhea
stories.summary: 134 passengers and 14 crew aboard a 12-night Caribbean cruise have fallen ill with symptoms of vomiting and diarreha.

stories.title: What ‘die with zero’ means, and who it is meant for
stories.summary: A money philosophy called "die with zero" is getting attention on social media. NerdWallet's Kate Ashford explains what it means and what comes first.

stories.title: InvestigateTV+: Firing college coaches can cost millions
stories.summary: Firing college football coaches can cost millions of dollars, and InvestigateTV+ has uncovered how, in some cases, students are helping to foot the bill.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI could outsell Taylor Swift’s entire Eras Tour in its first week, report says
stories.summary: Analysts project GTA 6 could generate $3.3 billion in launch-week sales, surpassing the Eras Tour’s $2.2 billion box office total.

stories.title: Honolulu bus driver shares aloha and carries on uncle’s legacy
stories.summary: For city bus driver Kainoa Kula Thomas, a friendly greeting can brighten a ride — and carry on a family legacy.

stories.title: Woman missing since 1994 identified in decades-old cold case
stories.summary: Authorities have made a breakthrough in a decades-old cold case involving a Virginia woman who disappeared in 1994.

stories.title: Larry Poindexter, ‘S.W.A.T.’ actor, dies at 66 after tragic accident
stories.summary: Larry Poindexter, an actor known for “S.W.A.T.,” “JAG” and “Days of Our Lives,” died at 66 after being hit by a car in Los Angeles.
